title: Your Boots Jump Before You See the Stick, Yet Your Conscious Brain Learns Last
description:
You think you jump back because you first felt afraid! Yet your boots leap away before your eyes recognize anything! This is the true story of the brain's two fear roads. Here is what went wrong with old emotion theories.
